privacy_intro: This policy explains, in plain language, what information Waka uses and how we use it.
privacy_collect_text: We collect the information you provide when you create and use your account, such as your name and email address. We also store the content and interactions you choose to share on Waka, along with basic technical information needed to keep the service secure and reliable.
privacy_use_text: We use this information to provide Waka, keep your account secure, help people connect, respond to requests, and improve the product. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy_share_text: Your public profile and content are visible to people who can access them in Waka. We may share limited information with trusted providers that help us operate the service, or when the law requires it.
privacy_choices_text: You can review and update the information in your account. You can also choose what you share publicly. If you have a privacy question, please contact the Waka team.
privacy_updates_text: If this policy changes, we will publish the updated version on this page. Continuing to use Waka after an update means you accept the revised policy.
terms_intro: These terms describe the simple rules for using Waka.
terms_using_text: By creating an account or using Waka, you agree to follow these terms and our privacy policy. You must provide accurate information and keep your account secure.
terms_content_text: You keep ownership of the content you post. By posting it, you give Waka permission to display and share it as needed to operate the service. Only share content you have the right to share.
terms_respect_text: Do not use Waka to break the law, harm others, impersonate people, distribute harmful software, or abuse the service. We may remove content or restrict accounts that violate these rules.
terms_changes_text: We work to keep Waka available and useful, but features may change or be temporarily unavailable. We may suspend or end access when necessary to protect the service or its community.
terms_updates_text: When these terms change, we will publish the new version on this page. By continuing to use Waka, you accept the updated terms.
